final_text:
**delta_app is deployed and live at https://delta-docs.rehearsal.invalid (deployed today at 13:52). One step is left: the signed-in tests.**

| Step | Where it stands |
|---|---|
| Brief, app settings, branding ("Delta Docs", #0B5D3B) | Done |
| Secret keys | Done. 13 of 17 are set, and the check counts that as enough to go on |
| Deploy | Done |
| Tests | **Waiting on you.** Nothing failed, but the functional, accessibility and responsiveness lanes skipped their signed-in checks |
| Extra code, extra workspaces, agent package, own web address, repository | None needed or asked for |

**What I need from you:** to finish the tests I have to sign in to delta_app as a real user, and that takes a one-time code sent by email.

1. Tell me which email address can sign in to delta_app.
2. Say plainly that I may send it a code.

After your yes, I'll ask delta_app to send that address a six-digit code. It usually arrives within a minute and expires after ten minutes. Paste just the six digits here. The sign-in it gives me is kept in a private file on this machine and is never shown in this chat. Then I'll re-run the skipped checks and tell you what they measured.
